payload.title: DfCM current frontier
payload.body: Frontier changed: canonical reusable independent-consumer court is contained in ggen-marketplace main 1bce7b3aa9cc74675126a6f2b9778a2331226824; ggen consumer contained in main f1c8e849f0b8045cc453e7d04a609e868d990637; cloud consumer contained in main 2117c4a06b715ef1a852654de0d210859a09d4ee. Weakest multiplier moved from existence of an independently ALIVE external consumer to breadth of consumer replication and downstream composition. Newly actionable concurrent edge: TensorFlow consumer master f8190fd2a8904b17ed0827d03033802ee5ba5556, currently reported write-authority constrained. Next: enumerate all compatible writable repositories, reproduce target-local receipts with shared court, and measure downstream manufacturing actions caused by each admitted consumer.
